shadows.name: floating-layer
shadows.purpose: Menus, drawers, and floating voice state only.

rules: Use honey for progress, voice, or selection.
Earn every container and every shadow.
Reuse mobile assets instead of redrawing them.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action in a region.
components.css: .bee-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #644a40; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; } .bee-primary:hover { background: #4f3931; }

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: A short suggested action for Bee.
components.html: <button class="bee-chip">What should I focus on today?</button>
components.css: .bee-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 16px; background: #fcfcfc; color: #202020; font: 600 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .bee-chip:hover { background: #efefef; }

components.name: Prompt Composer
components.description: Typed fallback and primary text input for Bee.
components.css: .bee-composer { display: flex; min-height: 48px; padding: 6px 8px 6px 16px; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 16px; background: #fcfcfc; } .bee-composer input { width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #202020; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; }
